$comment: Agent Fighter as a gauntlet title (node/gauntlet.js): for every match this node hosts, it runs the title's own match server for that match alone (packages/server/src/gauntlet-server.ts), with no database and no publisher key: players are the placed keys, seated by the node's tickets; the seed is the placement's; the server posts the signed log to this node's /ledger and exits. In node.env: GAUNTLETS=agent-fighter.v1=<absolute path to this file> and GAUNTLET_GATEWAY_PORT=8478 (the relay tunnel fronts the gateway; a node that still runs the always-on relay keeps RELAY_PORT=8477 behind it). cwd is an Agent Fighter checkout on the engine the live client plays (npm ci at its root); nothing in its .env is read. Machine-specific: copy and edit the paths.
